note: Rewritten by the 5pm and 7pm email scans.

items.title: Vocab Unit 1 test moved to Thursday 10 Sep
items.detail: Miss Peyton pushed it back from 9 Sep to give two full school days after the long weekend. She expects reviewing at home from now until the test. Four ways to study: the graded sketch notes packet, the word list in the Schoology Q1 Vocab folder, homemade flashcards, or a family member quizzing her from the shared list.

items.title: Optional: RSM Herndon middle school physics
items.detail: Mondays 4:20 to 5:50 pm with Dr. Iraida, at the Herndon branch rather than Ashburn. Launched 31 Aug and they said there was still room. Nothing has been committed.

items.title: Long weekend, no school Friday or Monday
items.detail: 4 Sep is a student holiday and 7 Sep is Labor Day. Next school day is Tuesday 8 Sep. Both are already in the calendar, so the letters below are correct.

items.title: New teacher messaging app, Rooms by Apptegy
items.detail: LCPS launched a two way messaging tool this year. It becomes the only channel for quick notes from teachers, coaches and activity leaders. Invitations went out 2 Sep by text or email and will be resent next week, but you can join without one. Download the LCPS app, allow notifications, pick Watson Mountain in the Feed tab, then use the Rooms or Messaging tab at the bottom. Schoology still holds assignments and ParentVUE still holds grades.

items.title: FY28 budget ThoughtExchange closes 15 Sep
items.detail: Optional. The School Board is collecting parent input on programs and investments for the 2027 to 2028 year, with slower revenue growth expected. Open at lcps.org/thoughtexchange.

items.title: Video Game Music Club, she is not eligible yet
items.detail: Runs Wednesdays after school, led by Mr. Klinberg. Sixth graders need at least one full year of playing plus permission from Ms. Holowecki, so this is a no for now. Ms. Holowecki is starting a Beginning Strings Club for beginners in the second club season and will send details as the first season closes. Fee carries an extra $15 that pays the professional guest musicians.

items.title: Shoulder rest still needed
items.detail: Mandatory and graded, since instrument posture is assessed. Buy by size, printed inside the f-hole and on the instrument contract. Everest EZ2A for half size, EZ4A for three quarter or full, or a foam sponge for any size.

items.title: Check she has the right math notebook
items.detail: Mrs. Reel asked families to verify it. The class uses it daily for notes, examples and practice.

items.title: Math homework runs on Mathspace, most nights
items.detail: Mrs. Reel expects homework after most classes, due the following class period, mostly on Mathspace. Every unit also has a Schoology folder with an agenda listing each day, assignments, completed notes and upcoming test dates. That agenda is the first place to look after an absence.

items.title: Mr. Dickerson's weekly US History update arrives Thursdays
items.detail: A PDF is attached covering the week and the email body says nothing, so open the attachment. Latest is 8-31-26.pdf.

items.title: Art 6 teacher is Ms. B. Thiele
items.detail: Art 6 Sem: Intro to Art, semester 1, blocks 1 and 2 on B days. Supply list still has not arrived.

items.title: Spectrum grades will never show in ParentVUE
items.detail: That class gives no traditional grades and uses the Schoology gradebook only.

items.title: Mountain Messenger is image only, open the accessible version
items.detail: Vol 3 Issue 4 landed 7 Sep. The newsletter is built entirely from graphics, so nothing is readable as text and the scan cannot pull items out of it. Use the View Accessible Mountain Messenger Document link at the top of the email. Fall intramurals, cross country running and 5v5 flag football, were announced in the previous issue.

items.title: Fall club registration closed 7 Sep
items.detail: The window shut today. Questions are now welcome at clubs@watsonmountainpto.org or clubs2@watsonmountainpto.org. Remember bus transport only runs for PM clubs, so an AM club means a morning drop off.

Holiday Monday, nothing moved. No new grades, no new assignments, no overdue. Science OIP study guide still due Tuesday 8 Sep and both Thursday items stand. Club registration closed today. New Mountain Messenger is image only, so open the accessible document link inside it.

No coursework change over the weekend, nothing new graded, no overdue. One urgent item: fall club registration opened to all families at 10am today and closes Monday 7 Sep, with some clubs already sold out.

Quiet day. No new grades, no new assignments, no overdue. Coursework unchanged: Science homework 8 Sep, vocab test and Science quiz both 10 Sep. From the LCPS Letter, teachers move to a new messaging app called Rooms inside the LCPS app, so download it. Kids Fest Monday and a budget survey closing 15 Sep.

Overdue list clear. Three new grades, Science OIP Knowledge Check 5/5, PE Procedures Major Summative 100/100, Math Data Cycle Study Guide 100/100. New Science OIP quiz added for 10 Sep. Art 6 teacher confirmed as Ms. Thiele. Fall intramurals announced.
